# Vendored Unicorn system bindings

This is the Rust FFI surface from `unicorn-engine-sys` 2.1.5, reduced to the pieces needed when
linking a prebuilt Unicorn shared library. The declarations in `src/bindings.rs` were generated by
that release's bindgen build and are kept in source so Android builds do not require host libclang,
pkg-config, CMake, or the QEMU-derived Unicorn C source tree.

`build.rs` requires dynamic linkage and an ABI-specific `UNICORN_LIB_DIR_<rust_target>` variable.
The Android Gradle task sets that variable to `app/src/main/jniLibs/<abi>`, where the matching
`libunicorn.so` is also picked up by APK packaging.

The upstream bindings and Unicorn are GPL-2.0; the upstream license is included as `COPYING`.
